title: Single right-moving scan step
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with no work tapes over the Boolean alphabet. Let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, let $q$ be a state, let $q'$ be an optional state, let $i<|x|$, let $o$ be a finite Boolean output string, and let $e$ be an optional Boolean symbol. Suppose that for every work-tape tuple, the transition from $q$ on the symbol $x[i]?$ is the action that moves right, has no work-tape actions, emits $e$, and enters state $q'$. Then one step from the scan configuration at position $i$ in state $q$ with output $o$ gives the scan configuration at position $i+1$ in state $q'$ with output $o$ followed by $e$ when present.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ has no work tapes and uses the Boolean alphabet
$o$ is a finite Boolean output string
For every work-tape tuple, the transition at $q$ on $x[i]?$ moves right, has no work-tape actions, emits $e$, and enters $q'$
